title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜
summary: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。
summaryEn: Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 四分之一波堆練習：設計 550 nm 的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 高反射膜 Glass | (HL)⁹H | air，n_H = 2.35、n_L = 1.46、n_s = 1.52。各層厚度 d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm、d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm，19 層總厚度 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm。導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴，R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998（無吸收時）。阻帶半寬 Δg ≈ 0.150，阻帶約 478 到 647 nm。若整批厚度一致偏厚 1%，整個光譜紅移 5.5 nm；以 10° 入射使用時藍移 0.44%（2.4 nm），兩者部分抵消。以 IBS 0.1 nm/s 沉積需 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h；石英晶體監控一層 94.2 nm 的 SiO₂ 對應 Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz。數值為教學假設，不代表任何鍍膜廠的設計或製程。
workedExample.textEn: Quarter-wave-stack exercise: design a 550 nm TiO₂/SiO₂ high reflector Glass | (HL)⁹H | air with n_H = 2.35, n_L = 1.46 and n_s = 1.52. Layer thicknesses are d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm and d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm, a 19-layer total of 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm. The admittance Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴, so R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998 without absorption. The stop-band half-width Δg ≈ 0.150 gives a band from about 478 to 647 nm. A uniform 1% thickness excess red-shifts the whole spectrum by 5.5 nm, while use at 10° incidence blue-shifts it by 0.44% (2.4 nm), partly cancelling. Depositing by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h; one 94.2 nm SiO₂ layer on the quartz-crystal monitor corresponds to Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions, not any coating shop's design or process.

workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加」與「特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition" and "Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單層膜的兩個界面」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The two interfaces of a single film” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅；兩束反射光的相位差由光程 2n₁d·cosθ 決定，彼此可以相消或相加。當光學厚度 n₁d 等於四分之一波長時，兩個界面的反射相位相反，若 n₁ 介於入射介質與基板之間反射率下降，若 n₁ 高於基板反射率反而上升；光學厚度為半波時薄膜「隱形」，反射率回到裸基板值。這個單層結果是所有干涉鍍膜的基本單元，也說明為何同一層膜在不同波長下行為完全不同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單層膜的兩個界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations; the phase difference between the two reflected waves is set by the path 2n₁d·cosθ, so they can cancel or reinforce. When the optical thickness n₁d equals a quarter wavelength the two reflections are in antiphase: reflectance drops if n₁ lies between the incident medium and substrate, but rises if n₁ exceeds the substrate index; at half-wave thickness the film is absentee and reflectance returns to the bare-substrate value. This single-layer result is the basic unit of every interference coating and shows why one film behaves completely differently at different wavelengths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The two interfaces of a single film”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單層膜的兩個界面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “The two interfaces of a single film”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單層膜的兩個界面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The two interfaces of a single film” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。TiO₂（n₁ = 2.35）鍍在 BK7（n_s = 1.52）上：R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323，由裸玻璃的 4.3% 升到 32%；同一層在半波波長（設計波長的一半）時 R 回到 4.3%。相位厚度 δ = 2πn₁d/λ，550 nm 的四分之一波 TiO₂ 厚度 d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]². For TiO₂ (n₁ = 2.35) on BK7 (n_s = 1.52): R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323, up from 4.3% for bare glass to 32%; at the half-wave wavelength (half the design wavelength) R returns to 4.3%. The phase thickness is δ = 2πn₁d/λ, so a quarter-wave TiO₂ layer for 550 nm has d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單層膜的兩個界面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “The two interfaces of a single film” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把高折射率單層誤當成增透膜鍍在透鏡上，反射率反而由 4% 升到 30%，整組鏡頭的穿透率與鬼影同時惡化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Depositing a high-index single layer as if it were an antireflection film raises reflectance from 4% to 30%, degrading lens transmission and ghost images together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆：原理與系統邊界

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quarter-wave stack and admittance” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多層膜用每層的 2×2 特徵矩陣連乘來計算，矩陣元素只含該層的折射率與相位厚度，整個膜系在入射側呈現一個等效導納 Y，反射率就是 [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]²。四分之一波層的矩陣特別簡單：它把後方的導納 Y 轉成 n²/Y，所以高低折射率交替的 (HL)ᴺ 堆每加一對就把導納乘上 (n_H/n_L)²，反射率隨對數迅速逼近 1。阻帶寬度只由折射率比決定，與層數無關；層數只決定阻帶內的反射率深度與帶邊陡度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四分之一波堆與導納」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A multilayer is computed by multiplying the 2×2 characteristic matrix of each layer, whose elements contain only that layer's index and phase thickness; the whole stack presents an equivalent admittance Y on the incident side, and reflectance is [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]². A quarter-wave layer has an especially simple matrix: it transforms the admittance behind it, Y, into n²/Y, so each added pair of an alternating (HL)ᴺ stack multiplies the admittance by (n_H/n_L)² and reflectance approaches 1 rapidly with pair count. The stop-band width depends only on the index ratio, not on the layer count; the count sets only the reflectance depth inside the band and the edge steepness. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quarter-wave stack and admittance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For glass | (HL)ᴺ | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s.

steps.title: 特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四分之一波堆與導納」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quarter-wave stack and admittance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Glass | (HL)ᴺ | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s。TiO₂/SiO₂（2.35/1.46）、N = 10 對、n_s = 1.52：(2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴，Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴，R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998。阻帶半寬 Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150，設計波長 550 nm 的阻帶約從 478 nm 延伸到 647 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For glass | (HL)ᴺ | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s. With TiO₂/SiO₂ (2.35/1.46), N = 10 pairs and n_s = 1.52: (2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴, Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴, R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998. The stop-band half-width Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150, so a 550 nm design has a stop band from about 478 nm to 647 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用薄膜設計軟體或自行寫的矩陣程式計算 (HL)¹⁰ 的光譜，核對阻帶中心反射率與帶邊位置是否與導納公式一致；再量測實鍍樣品的反射率，比較阻帶寬度（應只隨折射率比變化）與帶內漣波（反映厚度誤差）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the (HL)¹⁰ spectrum with thin-film software or your own matrix code and check that the central reflectance and band edges agree with the admittance formulas; then measure a deposited sample and compare the stop-band width, which should depend only on index ratio, and the in-band ripple, which reflects thickness errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「氧化物與氟化物膜材」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Oxide and fluoride film materials” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。材料選擇同時受吸收係數、應力、硬度與與基板的附著力限制。蒸鍍膜常呈柱狀多孔結構，堆積密度 0.8 到 0.9，孔隙吸水後折射率上升、光譜紅移；離子輔助或濺鍍能把密度推近 1，光譜才能穩定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The choice is also bounded by absorption coefficient, stress, hardness and adhesion to the substrate. Evaporated films are often columnar and porous with packing density 0.8 to 0.9; water filling the pores raises the index and red-shifts the spectrum, and only ion assistance or sputtering pushes density toward 1 so the spectrum stays stable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Oxide and fluoride film materials”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Oxide and fluoride film materials”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「氧化物與氟化物膜材」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Oxide and fluoride film materials” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性混合估計（教學假設）：堆積密度 p = 0.85 的 TiO₂ 膜，乾燥時 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275，孔隙吸水後 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325，光學厚度變化 Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2%，550 nm 的設計波長紅移約 12 nm；若 p = 0.98，同樣計算只得 0.3%，約 1.6 nm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material choice, absorption edge and packing density: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「氧化物與氟化物膜材」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Oxide and fluoride film materials” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用 TiO₂ 設計 350 nm 紫外濾光片，膜層在工作波段強烈吸收，穿透率只剩設計值的一半且雷射照射下升溫脫落；蒸鍍多孔膜出廠光譜合格，裝機後因吸濕紅移 10 nm 而失效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Designing a 350 nm ultraviolet filter with TiO₂ puts the working band inside its absorption, halving transmission and causing heating and delamination under laser exposure; a porous evaporated filter that passed at shipment fails after installation when humidity red-shifts it by 10 nm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。

steps.instruction: 電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。鍍 100 nm 的 SiO₂（ρ = 2.2 g/cm³）面密度 Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm²，Δf ≈ −1245 Hz；頻率解析度 0.1 Hz 對應約 0.008 nm，但工具因子若誤差 2%，100 nm 層就偏 2 nm。IBS 以 0.1 nm/s 沉積 1.5 µm 的 19 層堆需約 4.2 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal. Depositing 100 nm of SiO₂ (ρ = 2.2 g/cm³) adds Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm², so Δf ≈ −1245 Hz; a 0.1 Hz resolution corresponds to about 0.008 nm, but a 2% tooling-factor error puts a 100 nm layer off by 2 nm. Depositing a 1.5 µm, 19-layer stack by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes about 4.2 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors.

quiz.explanation: 鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors. steps.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deposition processes and thickness monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外；蒸鍍腔未加離子輔助，出廠合格的濾光片在濕季全部紅移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification; an evaporation chamber without ion assistance ships filters that all red-shift in the humid season. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「分光光度計與逆向工程」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。損耗以 1 − R − T 分解成吸收與散射，吸收由光熱或光腔衰盪法量到 ppm 等級，散射由總積分散射儀取得。對窄帶濾光片，中心波長對光學厚度極度敏感，所以驗證必須同時說明量測的波長準確度與光束發散角。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「分光光度計與逆向工程」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments. For narrowband filters the centre wavelength is extremely sensitive to optical thickness, so verification must state the wavelength accuracy and beam divergence of the measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「分光光度計與逆向工程」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition" is correct?

Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.
After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve.

quiz.explanationEn: After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分光光度計與逆向工程」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。全膜厚度一致偏 1%，550 nm 設計位移 5.5 nm；1550 nm 的 DWDM 濾光片 FWHM 1 nm，0.1% 的厚度誤差已造成 1.55 nm 位移，所以必須控制到 0.01%（0.15 nm）等級，這就是 IBS 配合光學監控的理由。損耗分解：R = 99.95%、T = 0.03% 時 A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). A uniform 1% thickness error shifts a 550 nm design by 5.5 nm; for a 1550 nm DWDM filter with 1 nm FWHM, a 0.1% error already shifts it 1.55 nm, so control must reach the 0.01% (0.15 nm) level, which is why IBS with optical monitoring is used. Loss decomposition: with R = 99.95% and T = 0.03%, A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。全膜厚度一致偏 1%，550 nm 設計位移 5.5 nm；1550 nm 的 DWDM 濾光片 FWHM 1 nm，0.1% 的厚度誤差已造成 1.55 nm 位移，所以必須控制到 0.01%（0.15 nm）等級，這就是 IBS 配合光學監控的理由。損耗分解：R = 99.95%、T = 0.03% 時 A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm。
knowledge.textEn: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). A uniform 1% thickness error shifts a 550 nm design by 5.5 nm; for a 1550 nm DWDM filter with 1 nm FWHM, a 0.1% error already shifts it 1.55 nm, so control must reach the 0.01% (0.15 nm) level, which is why IBS with optical monitoring is used. Loss decomposition: with R = 99.95% and T = 0.03%, A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition", which statement holds?
options: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。
鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。
層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。
optionsEn: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd).
A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.
More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.
quiz.explanation: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「分光光度計與逆向工程」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品。
薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring.

quiz.explanation: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分光光度計與逆向工程」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。斜入射時 s 與 p 偏振的 Fresnel 係數不同，阻帶寬度與帶邊位置分裂，45° 的分光鏡必須分別對兩個偏振設計。公差預算把厚度、折射率、均勻性與入射角誤差各自換算成波長位移，以均方根相加，再與規格的帶邊容差比較，決定哪一項必須被製程或量測收緊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. At oblique incidence the s and p Fresnel coefficients differ, so stop-band width and edge positions split, and a 45° beam splitter must be designed for each polarization separately. The tolerance budget converts thickness, index, uniformity and angle errors into wavelength shifts, adds them root-sum-square and compares the total with the specified edge tolerance to decide which term the process or metrology must tighten. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。取 n_eff = 1.85（TiO₂/SiO₂ 幾何平均）：θ = 10° 時位移 −0.44%，550 nm 設計移 −2.4 nm；θ = 45° 時 √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924，位移 −7.6%，約 −42 nm。帶邊公差 ±1%（±5.5 nm）的預算：厚度 0.5%、折射率 0.3%、均勻性 0.3%、入射角 ±2°（在 45° 附近約 0.5%），RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%，尚有餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²). With n_eff = 1.85 (the TiO₂/SiO₂ geometric mean): at θ = 10° the shift is −0.44%, −2.4 nm for a 550 nm design; at 45°, √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924, a −7.6% shift of about −42 nm. For an edge tolerance of ±1% (±5.5 nm) the budget of thickness 0.5%, index 0.3%, uniformity 0.3% and angle ±2° (about 0.5% near 45°) gives RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%, still within margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff; compare the measured within-batch shift distribution with the budget's RSS and, if the real spread is wider, locate the underestimated term one by one.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

For an edge tolerance of ±1% (±5.5 nm) the budget of thickness 0.5%, index 0.3%, uniformity 0.3% and angle ±2° (about 0.5% near 45°) gives RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%, still within margin.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A filter designed and verified at 0° installed in a 20° converging beam blue-shifts by 1.7% and broadens with the angle range, lowering system signal-to-noise; a 45° splitter designed for average polarization splits s and p 20% apart and fails polarization-dependent loss.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。每一批放入與產品同材料的見證片，用於光譜、附著與環境測試。環境耐久依 ISO 9211 或軍規序列進行：濕熱、鹽霧、溫度循環、膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗，確認膜層不會起泡、龜裂或脫落。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. Each batch carries witness samples of the same material as the product for spectral, adhesion and environmental tests. Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。源到基板 h = 600 mm，離軸 r = 150 mm：(1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129，厚度只有中心的 88.6%，即 11.4% 的落差；加上行星公轉與遮罩後，批內殘差可壓到 ±0.3%。環境測試後允許的光譜位移若為 ±0.5%，依第三單元的線性混合估計就要求堆積密度高於約 0.97。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]². For a source-to-substrate height h = 600 mm and off-axis radius r = 150 mm, (1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129, so the thickness is only 88.6% of centre, an 11.4% fall-off; planetary rotation plus masking brings the within-batch residual to ±0.3%. If the allowed spectral shift after environmental testing is ±0.5%, the linear-mixing estimate of unit 3 requires a packing density above about 0.97. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。
knowledge.textEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability"?
options: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。
optionsEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.
quiz.explanation: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing. steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」如何決定光學薄膜干涉鍍膜的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” determines the key performance of “Optical interference coatings”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。因為量測有不確定度，驗收必須設保護帶：量測值必須比規格好於量測不確定度的範圍才能判定合格。交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. Because measurements carry uncertainty, acceptance needs a guard band: the measured value must beat the specification by the measurement uncertainty before a pass is declared. The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。製程能力：帶邊規格 ±1.5%，製程位移標準差 σ = 0.33%（±1% 為 3σ），C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5，預期良率約 99.99%；若 σ 升到 0.5%，C_pk = 1.0，良率約 99.7%，每千片有 3 片超規。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%. Process capability: edge specification ±1.5% with a process shift standard deviation σ = 0.33% (±1% as 3σ) gives C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5 and an expected yield of about 99.99%; if σ rises to 0.5%, C_pk = 1.0 and yield about 99.7%, three parts per thousand out of specification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。製程能力：帶邊規格 ±1.5%，製程位移標準差 σ = 0.33%（±1% 為 3σ），C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5，預期良率約 99.99%；若 σ 升到 0.5%，C_pk = 1.0，良率約 99.7%，每千片有 3 片超規。
knowledge.textEn: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%. Process capability: edge specification ±1.5% with a process shift standard deviation σ = 0.33% (±1% as 3σ) gives C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5 and an expected yield of about 99.99%; if σ rises to 0.5%, C_pk = 1.0 and yield about 99.7%, three parts per thousand out of specification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%.
A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.
A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.

steps.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞；沒有批次編號，現場失效的濾光片無法回溯到同爐的見證片。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing; without batch numbers a field failure cannot be traced back to its witness samples.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。
knowledge.textEn: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格書、保護帶與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

quiz.explanationEn: Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞；沒有批次編號，現場失效的濾光片無法回溯到同爐的見證片。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing; without batch numbers a field failure cannot be traced back to its witness samples. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
